scripts.dev: docker compose up -d db && sleep 2 && docker exec lanas-db psql -U postgres -d lanas_db -f /dev/stdin < lanas-backend/database/schema.sql 2>/dev/null; concurrently --names "backend,store,backoffice" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix lanas-backend" "npm run dev --prefix lanas-store" "npm run dev --prefix lanas-backoffice"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix lanas-backend && npm install --prefix lanas-store && npm install --prefix lanas-backoffice
